CONFIG=$1

export HCCL_WHITELIST_DISABLE=1

MASTER_ADDR=${MASTER_ADDR:-"10.64.60.51"}

export PYTHONPATH="$(dirname $0)/..":$PYTHONPATH

# launch core setting
KERNEL_NUM=$(($(nproc)/GPUS))

# dist env setting
export WORLD_SIZE=$((NNODES*GPUS))
export MASTER_ADDR=$MASTER_ADDR
export MASTER_PORT=$PORT
LOCAL_RANK_START=$((NODE_RANK*GPUS))
LOCAL_RANK_END=$((LOCAL_RANK_START+GPUS))

for((RANK_ID=LOCAL_RANK_START;RANK_ID<LOCAL_RANK_END;RANK_ID++))
do
	export RANK=$RANK_ID
	PID_START=$((KERNEL_NUM*(RANK_ID%GPUS)))

        echo "PID_START: $PID_START"

	nohup taskset -c $PID_START-$PID_END \

	--config $CONFIG \
        --no-validate \
        --work-dir work_dist_cpu_8_light \
        --seed 0 \
	--launcher pytorch ${@:3} \  > train_dist_cpu_8_light.log 2>&1 &
done

#dist_train_cpu.sh 单机多卡
```
CONFIG=$1
GPUS=$2

NNODES=${NNODES:-2} #NNODES默认为1，几台服务器
NODE_RANK=${NODE_RANK:-0}

export ASCEND_SLOG_PRINT_TO_STDOUT=0
export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0
export HCCL_WHITELIST_DISABLE=1
export HCCL_IF_IP=10.64.50.51  

PORT=${PORT:-29500}
MASTER_ADDR=${MASTER_ADDR:-"10.64.60.51"}

export PYTHONPATH="$(dirname $0)/..":$PYTHONPATH

nohup python3 -m torch.distributed.launch \
        --nnodes=$NNONES \
        --node_rank=$NODE_RANK \
        --master_addr=$MASTER_ADDR \
        --nproc_per_node=$GPUS \
        --master_port=$PORT \
        $(dirname "$0")/train.py \
	--config $CONFIG \
        --no-validate \
        --work-dir work_dist_8_light \
        --seed 0 \
	--launcher pytorch ${@:3} \  > train_dist_8_light.log 2>&1 &
done
```

要点：
- 多机时 `init_process_group` 的 `rank` **必须用全局 `os.environ["RANK"]`**（官方单机页示例用 `rank=local_rank_idx`，多机不可照搬）。
- 绑定用 `torch_npu.npu.set_device(local_rank)`（或 `torch.npu.set_device`）。
- `DistributedDataParallel(model, device_ids=[local_rank], output_device=local_rank)` 为官方另一写法。
